content.value: Preown is a technology and retail business dealing in verified pre-owned electronic devices and accessories, as well as selected new/sealed electronic products.

Products may include:
- Smartphones
- Tablets
- Laptops
- Smartwatches
- Earphones
- Accessories
- Other electronic products.
Products may be sold directly by Preown or, where applicable, through verified sellers/partners associated with the Preown platform.
Pre-owned products are previously owned products and may show reasonable signs of prior use depending on their stated condition or grade.
Preown does not represent a pre-owned product as brand new unless the product is specifically identified as New, Brand New, Factory Sealed or Sealed Box.

sections.title: Scope of Application — Online & Offline Transactions

content.value: These Terms are not limited to purchases made through the Preown website.

The applicable warranty, return, refund, replacement, inspection and product-condition terms shall apply based on the product category and transaction, irrespective of the channel through which the purchase was made.
Preown makes reasonable efforts to ensure that product descriptions, specifications, photographs, prices, condition grades and other information provided to customers are accurate.

However:
- Actual product colour may vary slightly from photographs or displays.
- Minor cosmetic differences may exist between photographs and the delivered product.
- Specifications may vary according to model, region and configuration.
- Battery health/capacity of pre-owned devices may vary.
- Included accessories will be based on the product listing, invoice or purchase confirmation.
- Original packaging, accessories or documentation may not always be available unless specifically mentioned.
Customers are responsible for reviewing the product model, storage, configuration, condition, accessories and other relevant details before completing a purchase.
All pre-owned products are sold in their pre-owned condition, unless expressly stated otherwise.
The cosmetic condition of a product will be determined according to Preown's applicable grading system or product description.
Cosmetic imperfections that have been disclosed to the customer before purchase will not ordinarily be treated as manufacturing defects or warranty defects.
The inspection process may vary depending on the product.
Inspection and verification do not mean that a pre-owned device is equivalent to a brand-new device.

Customers purchasing products through delivery are required to record a continuous, uninterrupted unboxing video from the time the package is received until the product and its contents have been completely inspected.
The video should not contain cuts, edits or interruptions.
Video proof is mandatory for claims relating to physical damage, damage discovered during unboxing, missing items, package tampering or similar delivery/unboxing disputes.
Customers should retain the original video until the transaction is completely resolved.
Return, refund and replacement eligibility depends on the product category and the applicable Preown policy.
A customer must raise a return/replacement request within the applicable period specified by Preown.
Submitting a return request does not automatically mean that the return, refund or replacement has been approved.
Any refund, replacement or other applicable resolution will be processed only after the returned product has been physically received by Preown and successfully inspected and verified.
The inspection and verification process may take approximately 5–10 business days from the date Preown receives the returned product.

In certain cases, inspection may take longer where additional technical testing, manufacturer/service-centre verification, seller verification, courier investigation or other reasonable investigation is required.
Where a refund is approved after inspection, Preown will initiate the refund through the applicable payment method or another legally permitted method.
The time taken for the amount to appear in the customer's account may additionally depend on the relevant bank, card issuer, UPI provider or payment gateway.
Where a replacement is approved after inspection, Preown will arrange the replacement subject to product availability.

If the same model, configuration or colour is unavailable, Preown may offer an equivalent alternative or another appropriate resolution, subject to applicable law and customer acceptance where required.
Nothing in these Terms is intended to restrict mandatory consumer rights under applicable Indian law.

Where a product is sold as New, Brand New, Factory Sealed or Sealed Box, the applicable manufacturer's warranty, return policy and service terms will generally be provided and administered by the respective product brand/manufacturer or its authorized service network, and not by Preown, unless Preown expressly states otherwise in writing.
Preown may assist customers in communicating with the relevant brand or authorized service provider where reasonably possible.
However, the final decision regarding manufacturer warranty claims, repairs, replacements or manufacturer services will be subject to the respective brand's policies.
Preown does not provide a separate Preown warranty for a new/sealed product unless specifically mentioned on the product listing, invoice or warranty document.

New or factory-sealed products are generally not eligible for return merely because the customer has changed their mind, selected the wrong model/storage/colour, or no longer wishes to purchase the product, subject to applicable law.

sections.title: Mandatory Unboxing Video — New / Sealed Products

content.value: For all new/sealed products delivered to customers, a continuous and uninterrupted unboxing video is mandatory for any claim involving physical damage, missing items, package tampering or similar unboxing-related issues.
The video must not contain cuts, edits or interruptions.
Preown may request the original unedited video file for verification.

sections.title: Damage During Unboxing — New / Sealed Products

content.value: The claim will be reviewed after the relevant evidence and product are received and inspected.
A refund or replacement is not confirmed merely because damage has been reported.
Where a return is approved, the product must be received by Preown and inspected before any refund or replacement is processed.
The inspection process may take approximately 5–10 business days from receipt of the returned product.

Where the customer fails to provide the required unboxing video or sufficient evidence, Preown may be unable to verify whether damage, missing items or tampering existed before, during or after delivery/unboxing.

Accordingly, claims relating to physical damage, missing items, tampering or unboxing-related issues may be rejected where the required evidence is unavailable, subject to applicable consumer protection laws and statutory rights.
